primary.title: Small-cap corrections have narrowed to 25% post-covid: SageOne’s Samir Vartak
primary.summary: Cleaner balance sheets, stronger earnings growth, and manufacturing-led demand have made small caps far more resilient to market pullbacks than in pre-covid years, said the founder and chief investment officer of SageOne Investment Managers.
